intermediates.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate an ORIGINAL Galehorn Strider battle animation sprite sheet from this creature reference, not copyrighted game art. Preserve six slender hoofed legs, silver-blue scaled hide, swept long twisted pale horns, golden eyes, long tufted tail and wispy mane. Exactly SIXTEEN complete poses in FOUR columns by FOUR rows with generous empty gutters; same body size and elevated three-quarter camera in every cell, facing RIGHT. Row 1: relaxed standing; chest inhale tail gently raised; walk contact A near front leg forward and near rear leg back; passing A near front leg lifted under chest. Row 2: walk contact B near front leg BACK and near rear leg FORWARD, clearly opposite of contact A; passing B opposite foreleg raised; horn attack anticipation neck lowered and rear legs braced; forward horn thrust neck extended and front legs spread catching weight. Row 3: attack recovery head lifting; defensive low brace horns protecting face; defensive impact head bowed and legs flexed; hit recoil chest back with forelegs off ground. Row 4: dying knees buckling; falling onto SIDE with six legs folding; body settling flat; fully DEAD resting on side, limp legs and head/horns down, eyes closed. No blood. Real anatomy articulation, not repeated standing cutouts, translations, rotations or scale effects. Keep full horns and tail within every cell; no creature touches a neighboring cell. Consistent detailed painted raster style and proportions from reference. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, ground, shadows, text, labels, grid, smoke, particles, outlines or colored matte.
